The patient reports feeling down for about three months, since losing a job in July. The patient reports crying almost every day and not enjoying anything.
The patient reports waking up at four in the morning and not being able to get back to sleep, resulting in about five hours of sleep per night.
The patient reports a bad appetite and a ten-pound weight loss.
The patient reports sometimes wishing they would not wake up, but denies wanting to kill themselves and having a plan. The patient denies any prior attempts to hurt themselves.
The patient denies prior psychiatric hospitalizations. The patient reports seeing a therapist once in college.
The patient reports their mother had depression and their uncle drank a lot.
The patient reports stopping drinking a year ago and denies other drug use.
The patient reports taking lisinopril, ten milligrams, for blood pressure.
The patient reports no known allergies.
